candidate_selection: within-category robust z-score over all heads; no fixed candidate cap
matched_null: within source, category, and ordered label-transition pattern; cyclically permute right-side donors among sampled pairs
AP_test: one-sided source-level sign-flip test on observed-minus-null mean absolute symmetric patch contribution
CF_test: two-sided source-level sign-flip test on observed-minus-null label-aligned symmetric patch contribution
final_selection: BH q-value, source-bootstrap 95% confidence interval, bootstrap sign stability, and candidate recurrence across inner folds
final_head_count: adaptive; no fixed minimum or maximum
